mediaReview.title: Media review
mediaReview.uploadResult: {{received}} file(s) received, {{failed}} failed. Files remain private until approved.
mediaReview.reconciled: The receipt confirms that the request was recorded. Data has been refreshed.
mediaReview.subtitle: Shared rules, one gallery and individual review for exceptions.
mediaReview.chooseMedia: Choose an image to review its content and exceptions.
mediaReview.reviewRestrictions: I reviewed the usage restrictions for this image.
mediaReview.manualReview: Human review remains available without AI. Accepting media does not authorize publication.
mediaReview.acceptanceReviewConfirm: By approving, you confirm that you reviewed this image, its description and its restrictions. Website selection and publication remain separate steps.
mediaReview.reviewPermissionsHelp: Before accepting “{{name}}”, record the usage permission actually received and its evidence. After saving, you will return to this file to complete its description and continue the review. Recording permissions does not accept the media.
mediaReview.websiteExposure: This media will be selected for the website. It may become visible immediately if the dossier is already visible and eligible. This action does not authorize any social publication.
mediaReview.websiteRemoval: This action removes this media from website display. It does not delete the file or change any social publication.
mediaReview.rulesHelp: Permissions require real evidence. Automated analysis cannot grant legal rights.
mediaReview.coverage: The evidence must cover these {{count}} files. Future files are not included automatically.
mediaReview.futureCoverage: The supplied evidence also covers future files in this dossier or batch. I explicitly authorize those files to inherit these rules.
mediaReview.planHelp: Review the exact content of these {{count}} files and their permissions before confirming.
mediaReview.blockedPlan: This selection contains blockers. Resolve them or remove the affected media before preparing another decision.
mediaReview.noPublication: This decision does not schedule or publish content. Distribution requires its own authorization.
mediaReview.manifestConfirmation: I reviewed the files, alternative text, permissions and restrictions. I confirm this action on the exact selection shown.
mediaReview.uncertainHelp: The request outcome is uncertain. Changes are suspended until its receipt is verified. Do not repeat the operation elsewhere.
mediaReview.noReceipt: No confirmed receipt yet. Check again without repeating the operation.
mediaReview.historyPrivate: Private history of rights, decisions and operations.
mediaReview.inheritConfirm: Confirm restoring inherited permissions for this media.

errors.loadFailed: Media could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.planFailed: The decision could not be prepared. Refresh the media before trying again.
errors.changed: The dossier changed or the decision was refused. Review the refreshed information.
errors.uncertain: The receipt has not been confirmed.
errors.forbidden: Your permissions do not allow this action.

reasons.MEDIA_USAGE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Evidence of usage permission is required.
reasons.MODERATION_RESTRICTED: A moderation restriction blocks this media.
reasons.MEDIA_ANALYSIS_FAILED: Analysis failed: human review is required.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_DOSSIER_INELIGIBLE: This dossier is not eligible for preparation. Check its conditions and consent.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: This service does not include media in its current format.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_KIND_UNSUPPORTED: This media type is incompatible with the service.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_REVIEW_RESTRICTED: A review restriction prevents this assignment.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: This media is not assigned to this service.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_TARGET_CHANGED: The service changed. Refresh before confirming.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_VERSION_CONFLICT: The expected version changed. Refresh the selection.
reasons.MEDIA_PREPARATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: The media and service must belong to the same dossier.
reasons.MEDIA_CHANNEL_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Usage rights do not permit this channel.
reasons.MEDIA_TARGET_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Usage rights do not permit this destination.
reasons.MEDIA_TRANSFORMATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Usage rights do not permit the required processing.

analysis.title: Analysis and proposals
analysis.technicalOnly: Local technical analysis is available. Vision and OCR are not configured; no visual content or legal rights are inferred.
analysis.assisted: A person must verify proposals. They grant neither legal rights nor media approval.
analysis.error: Analysis or its review is unavailable. Manual review remains available.

library.title: Profile and media
library.subtitle: Intelligent library · Preparing content for promised services
library.identityMissing: Some dossier information is incomplete. Manage contact details in Identity.
library.submissionPending: The sponsor has not submitted their form yet. An administrative correction does not replace submission.
library.correctionsHelp: Review the sponsor’s photo preference and correction request here. Decisions and their explanations remain recorded in Funding. To address the content of a specific media file, open its inspector and moderation options.
library.preparationHelp: Checks and private assignments for this dossier. Human decisions, visibility and delivery remain separate.
library.oneDossier: Only resources from the open dossier.
library.documentsHelp: This view contains images classified as documents by an available analysis. PDF and office document uploads are not supported. Invoices and credit notes remain in Finances.
library.presentationHelp: Logos, the current website selection and media assigned to services. A private assignment prepares work without making a file public.
library.pageSelectionHelp: “Select this page” adds only the displayed files. Ready media are selected from the filtered results, up to 100 files.
library.emptyHelp: Add photos or a logo, or adjust the filters to find files.
library.preflightUnavailable: No Preflight assignment recommendation is available here. Funding technical checks and human review remain available.
library.attentionHelp: Check permissions, descriptions and content before deciding.
library.noLogo: No logo file in this library. An older dossier logo may exist separately; it is not imported automatically.
library.privateAssignmentHelp: This assignment is private preparation. It approves neither media nor the service and changes no visibility or publication authorization.

uploadStates.not_processed: Not sent · batch limit or safe stop

library.correctionNoMessage: The correction request will be recorded in Funding and affected authorizations will be invalidated. This action sends no email.
library.exportHelp: A processed WebP file will be offered for download for each media item in this exact selection. No originals or ZIP archive are generated. Files remain private and permissions are checked for every request.
library.exportConfirmation: I confirm the private export of these {{count}} files and the displayed versions.
library.exportRecovery: The receipt confirms the export, but file reception still needs verification. You can retrieve the same file without creating a new operation.

exportStates.failed: Check access, version or file availability
exportStates.not_processed: Not processed after the batch stopped

effects.ACCEPT_MEDIA_ONLY: Accept only the review of the selected media.
effects.WEBSITE_SELECTION_SEPARATE: Website selection remains a separate decision.
effects.PRIVATE_MEDIA_PREPARATION_ONLY: Record only a private preparation assignment.
effects.WEBSITE_SELECTION_UNCHANGED: Keep the current website selection unchanged.
effects.MEDIA_CORRECTION_REQUESTED: Record a correction request for the affected media.
effects.INVALIDATE_AFFECTED_APPROVALS: Invalidate authorizations affected by this change; a new decision may be required.
effects.REVOKE_MEDIA: Remove the media and revoke affected access and uses under Funding rules.
effects.DURABLE_STORAGE_CLEANUP: Record durable file cleanup; execution is tracked separately.
effects.SELECT_FOR_ELIGIBLE_PUBLIC_WEBSITE: Select for the public website: media may become visible immediately if the dossier is already visible and eligible.
effects.other: An additional effect requires verification before confirming.
